summary.text: Lorig Charkoudian is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 20, where she has served since January 9, 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Charkoudian's 2025-2026 committee assignments, according to Ballotpedia, include the Economic Matters Committee, the Administrative, Executive and Legislative Review Committee, and the Unemployment Insurance Oversight Committee, where she is House chair.
